subject: Docking call: MSA redline + onboarding checkpoint
body:
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@elmstreethealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@elmstreethealth.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the demos last week — the execs were encouraged. Legal attached a marked-up MSA (see ElmStreet_MSA_redline_v2.pdf) and procurement asked if we can set a short call to walk the key redlines and confirm the onboarding timeline before EOY.

Ideal agenda: 10–15 minute redline runthrough, list of gating items for procurement (SLA, data residency, audit logs), and a quick 15-minute onboarding checkpoint to map kickoff steps.

We were hoping to do this Tues or Wed next week (Dec 29–30). Our procurement lead (copied) will be on the call. Do you have 30 minutes open either day?

Best,
Dana Lopez
Director of Procurement
Elm Street Health
Attachment: ElmStreet_MSA_redline_v2.pdf (pdf, 187KB)
Attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@elmstreethealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Dana — thanks for sending these over and for the clear agenda. We can absolutely do a focused session. Ben (legal ops) and Kim (implementation manager) are the right folks to walk redlines and onboarding runbook.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Dec 29: 09:00–09:30 or 13:00–13:30
- Wed Dec 30: 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30

Draft agenda (30 min):
- 0–12m: legal redline highlights (Ben)
- 12–20m: procurement gating checklist (Kim + Dana)
- 20–28m: onboarding timeline and initial milestones (Kim)
- 28–30m: next steps and doc owners

I can take notes and create a short follow-up with action owners. If any of these windows work, I’ll send a calendar invite with the Google Doc link.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
VP, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Looping in Laura from Legal Ops for any procurement-specific evidence requests and to pre-flag one ask: Elm Street asked for a 13-month data retention option in section 6.b — I put a short note in the attachment and can walk rationale + fallbacks on the call.

Kim — can you confirm if the 11:00–11:30 Wed slot is feasible for implementation to attend? We should avoid the 09:00 slot if possible; our infra lead is OOO that morning.

Thanks — I’ll also prepare a two-slide summary of the redlines so we stay within the 12-minute redline window.

-Ben

---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@elmstreethealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Dec 2026 07:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Hi all — thanks for the options. We can cover implementation details at 11:00–11:30 PST on Wed Dec 30.

A couple of quick notes for the agenda so procurement can prep:
- Please have the SOC2 scope and any required data residency language ready to point to clauses (if possible).
- If Elm Street requests alternative retention terms, we need use-case context (audit/legal/regulatory) so we can map to technical options.
- I’ll share an onboarding runbook fragment in the meeting invite (kickoff -> SSO -> test data -> pilot -> go-live).

I’ll schedule 11:00–11:30 PST Wed and include a Google Doc link and the DocuSign skeleton for the MSA so legal can see the signing flow.

—Kim

---
From: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@elmstreethealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@elmstreethealth.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Thanks — appreciate the quick coordination. One change: our VP of IT had an all-hands start at 11 and asked if we could move to 12:30–13:00 PST instead (same 30-minute duration). Apologies for the late shuffle.

If that works for Redwood, we’ll both bring the procurement and security reps. If not, we can keep 11:00 and our VP will send notes.

Dana

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Lopez <dana.lopez@elmstreethealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Dec 2026 09:25:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA redline and onboarding checkpoint

Dana — 12:30–13:00 PST works on our side. I’ve updated the invite and included:
- Google Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3c_elmdoc
- DocuSign preview link: https://www.docusign.com/ELM-2026-7
- Attachments: ElmStreet_MSA_redline_v2.pdf, procurement_requirements.xlsx

Action items captured for the call:
- Ben: 2-slide redline summary + position on retention clause (6.b)
- Kim: onboarding runbook fragment + pilot milestone dates
- Laura: list of evidence artifacts for procurement (SOC2, audit logs, KMS certs)
- Dana/Elm Street: procurement + security reps to confirm SOC2 scope and desired retention use cases

See you at 12:30 PST. I’ll record the call and follow up with an ownersheet after.

Cheers,
Stephanie
VP, GTM Programs
Redwood Inference

---
[Calendar invite created: MSA redline & onboarding checkpoint — Wed Dec 30, 2026 12:30–13:00 PST]
